$comment: Hand-authored UBL document envelope descriptor for the ESPD Request/Response, grounded in the schematron BASE samples (espd-validation-schematron/common/xml/ESPD-{Request,Response}-BASE.xml). It describes (a) the document root element + the full namespace/schemaLocation attribute set, and (b) the mandatory HEADER elements that NO mapping sidecar emits — the fixed/generated envelope scalars (UBLVersionID … VersionID). The remaining header blocks (ProcedureCode, ContractingParty, EconomicOperatorParty, ProcurementProject/Lot) come from the admin mapping sidecars; the composer assembles everything in the fixed UBL order. Values marked "generated": true are supplied per-document by compose-document.mjs (ID, UUID, IssueDate, IssueTime); the rest are fixed constants from the BASE. CAVEAT: the BASE samples are the authoritative target; keep this in sync if a BASE revision changes the envelope.

header.$comment: ContractFolderID is the buyer's procedure reference. The VALUE comes from the instance (partI.procedure.fileReference.value) via the Part I §C sidecar when present; this envelope entry supplies the envelope FALLBACK + the mandatory @schemeAgencyID (BR-OTH-02). The composer uses the instance value/agency when present and this fallback otherwise.
